spanish: Su ofrenda: plato de plata uno, treinta y cien su peso; tazón uno plata, setenta siclo en siclo de la santidad; los dos ellos llenos sólet amasada en el aceite a minjá.

findings.issue: סֹלֶת is a common noun left untranslated as sólet; common nouns stay Spanish.
מִנְחָה is a common noun left untranslated as minjá; common nouns stay Spanish.
amasada narrows the passive participle (mixed) toward kneading into dough.

notes: Remaining clauses match the tokens, including thirty-and-a-hundred, the unsuffixed first weight, singular שֶׁקֶל, and בַשֶּׁמֶן as en el aceite.
